exact.messagebox: Message box: background, texture, then 12 rectangles x1,y1,x2,y2: inside, corners top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, frame top, bottom, left, right, corner 'centre' (TL/BR), shift and margins. Scale X/Y = base resolution of the coordinates
exact.introtexturefadein: Intro shown on a texture: fade-in time (seconds)
exact.introtexturetime: Intro shown on a texture: display time (seconds)
exact.introtexturefadeout: Intro shown on a texture: fade-out time (seconds)
exact.introtexture9fadeout: Fade-out time of the last intro (it stays on screen while loading)
exact.bkglinks: Backgrounds: name, file, scale X, scale Y
exact.mapmaskcoordinates: Map mask: width, height, midX, midY, rangeMask, rangeMapSign. The mask starts at 0,0 of the map particle, scale 1 for 1024; map signs are shown within rangeMapSign (a bit smaller than rangeMask)
exact.progresscoordsscale: Base resolution of the progress bar coordinates (meaning taken from the name)
exact.quickassignconfig: Quick-assign bar configuration (meaning taken from the name)
exact.skillline_texture: Texture of the skill tree lines (meaning taken from the name)
exact.skillline_availablecolor: Colour of available skill tree lines (meaning taken from the name)
exact.skillline_notavailablecolor: Colour of unavailable skill tree lines (meaning taken from the name)
exact.customwavexctrlselect: Sound: changing the selected item with the gamepad
exact.customwaveopenclosecombo: Sound: opening / closing a combo box
exact.customwavesetslider: Sound: moving a slider by one step (start of scrolling)
exact.customwavecustom1: Sound: scrolling the hero types in the hero creation dialog
